title: The Missing Broadsheet
description: The Gazette's evening press has gone dark two nights running, and its printer hasn't been seen since. Broadsheets don't stop running themselves — someone leaned on him, or worse, and the presses in this city rarely stay quiet by accident.

phase_ask_around.objectiveText: Ask around the Lantern Ward — barkeeps and bouncers hear things printers don't say to the Watch.

phase_confront_the_buyer.objectiveText: Someone paid good silver to keep that press silent. Find out who, and ask them why in person.
